status: DRAFT - Phase 02 feasibility, not an evaluation set
audioPolicy: Generated audio is ignored by the repository's existing *.wav rule. The manifest and recipes are the committed artefacts. Root ignore rules were not amended and no audio was force-added.
honestyRules: Analytic fixtures are generated signals, not speech.
Silence and gap labels are exact by construction; natural speech onset labels are not.
A TTS input script is not proof the rendered audio contains a hesitation.
Filler labels require a named human reviewer who listened; none are recorded yet.
The candidate detector's own prediction is never treated as ground truth.

labelProvenance.note: The inserted burst has exact sample indices. That is not the same as a confirmed filled pause: no listener has judged it. This fixture may be used for boundary-preservation mechanics, never as filler ground truth.

fixtures.description: Two acoustically distinct tokens in the same position. Which one a listener would call a lexical 'like' and which a filler is UNVERIFIED; this fixture exists to keep both classes in the evaluation set.

labelProvenance.note: A forced aligner would map whichever token is in the supplied text. It cannot decide which token was a filler. Do not score this fixture with filler precision/recall until a reviewer labels it.
